test_join_asof_backward_strategy: test the join_asof method with strategy backward to match each left row with the nearest right row whose key is less than or equal to the left key
test_join_asof_forward_strategy: test the join_asof method with strategy forward to match each left row with the nearest right row whose key is greater than or equal to the left key
test_join_asof_nearest_strategy: test the join_asof method with strategy nearest to match each left row with the closest right row regardless of direction
test_join_asof_with_by_grouping: test the join_asof method with by parameter to perform asof joins within sorted groups defined by a grouping column
test_join_asof_with_tolerance: test the join_asof method with tolerance parameter to restrict matches to rows within a specified time or numeric distance
